titulo.alumno: Explaining the effects of a measure

intro: Describe possible benefits and costs without presenting a causal link as certain.

texto: If there is not enough evidence, use «mogelijk» (possibly), «kan» (can) and «lijkt» (seems). Distinguish an observed change from the proposed explanation.

frases.estudio: Sinds de nieuwe buslijn rijdt, komen meer reizigers met het openbaar vervoer.
frases.alumno: Since the new bus line started running, more travellers use public transport.

frases.estudio: Dat kan met de betere verbinding te maken hebben.
frases.alumno: That may have to do with the better connection.

frases.estudio: De kosten zijn wel hoger dan verwacht.
frases.alumno: However, the costs are higher than expected.

frases.estudio: Misschien moeten we ook de bezetting in de spits meten.
frases.alumno: Perhaps we should also measure occupancy during the rush hour.

frases.estudio: Dan kunnen we de maatregel na drie maanden beoordelen.
frases.alumno: Then we can assess the measure after three months.
